question: Among the earlier transesterification studies that the Aspen Plus biodiesel models are compared with, which reports the highest conversion, and at what reaction temperature and methanol-to-oil ratio?
rendered: According to Table 11 in the document, the study by Harb & Jaoudeh (2025) reports the highest conversion of 95% at a reaction temperature of 60 °C and a methanol-to-oil ratio of 12:1.
